title: Diketo: Stones
tagline: Toss one, take the rest, catch it before it falls.
description: The traditional Southern African stone-toss game on a swept dirt yard. Take the pile out of the hole and back in, stage by stage, with a timed toss and catch. Five computer levels, pass and play, lessons and Watch & Learn.
genre: stone toss and pick-up skill game
howToPlay: Hold the pad to set the toss height, release to toss.
While the stone is in the air, tap or drag across the stones to take.
Tap CATCH when the ring closes on the landing spot.
Move the pile out of the hole and back in, stage by stage.
Drop it and the turn passes: the first to finish the last stage wins.
